verdict.rationale: Phaser Studio ships a first-party Phaser Editor with a Scene Editor where you drag and drop objects into place, an Inspector view for configuring filters in real time, layer reorganisation, and tilemap/atlas editors. However, the core framework documents a code-first workflow (creating game objects in a scene's create() method), and the editor is a separate licensed companion product rather than the engine's primary authoring path. Missing for 10: any evidence of prefab support, explicit viewport documentation, in-depth editor docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the editor as a level-building workflow.
